dialog.en: In light of the latest statement, the total housing cost is close to our budget ceiling.

dialog.speaker: jieun
dialog.ko: 대신 회사까지 자전거로 갈 수 있어서 교통비는 줄겠어요.

dialog.en: Since I work from home two days a week, the heating matters more than the distance.

dialog.speaker: jieun
